description_en: Sets the callback URL and callback authentication code for a whiteboard application
description_zh: 为白板应用设置回调服务地址及回调鉴权码
kebab_example: aliyun rtc-white-board set-app-callback-url --app-id 7mbj0000 --app-callback-url http://www.example.com/callback --app-callback-auth-key CallbackSecret123 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetAppCallbackUrl

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the whiteboard application. To obtain the whiteboard application ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204234.html
parameters.help_zh: 白板应用唯一标识符。获取白板应用ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204234.html
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The callback URL of the whiteboard application
parameters.name: app_callback_url

parameters.help_en: The callback authentication code of the whiteboard application, consisting of 8 to 20 characters including uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, or underscores
parameters.help_zh: 白板应用回调鉴权码，由8~20位大小写字母、数字或下划线组成
parameters.name: app_callback_auth_key
